label: Given dependence, each unde bridge is equivalent to what it delivers
paraphrase: Premise-free, over every grades frame. (1) Given R-dep, the first 'unde' bridge is equivalent to 'esse is the actuality of every form had in act'. (2) Given R-dep, the first bridge and the nature in act, the second bridge is equivalent to 'whatever is not its own being has its esse received in its nature'. (3) Given R-dep, the first bridge and the witness premise, inclusion is equivalent to R-act2. (4) On the dependence reading (ACTUALIZED_THROUGH_1) the first bridge holds in every frame. So each bridge carries exactly the content it is used to deliver: the inference makes the act-of-being commitment explicit and does not derive it from dependence.
